release.notes: Pre-purchase check: stops while charging, plugged in or at 10 kW and more; if the car reports no speed, a fresh, low battery power reading counts as rest once you confirm the car is parked (works indoors without GPS; assumed, not measured); History: consumption in your unit, short charges should no longer show the previous charge's energy; Trip Manager suggests more missed charging stops; adapter type list with examples; nameplate model code on the Battery Test certificate; Android Auto: tile values should fit narrow split screens, SoC in navigation; e-NV200 via OVMS v3: front tyre sides.
